description: We are a team of curious students passionate about space exploration, aerospace engineering, and technology. We're building an interactive Space Mission Design Game that combines science, engineering, and gameplay to make mission planning fun and educational. We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in web development, game design, UI/UX, animations, space research, or testing. Creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are always welcome. Let's build something memorable together!
summary:
GTA NASA: The Kepler Expedition is an immersive, interactive space exploration and mission simulation game designed to make space exploration engaging, educational, and collaborative. Inspired by NASA's space missions, the project allows players to design spacecraft, build missions, explore space, and experience realistic mission challenges.

We developed an interactive platform featuring spacecraft customization, AI-powered mission architecture, mission simulation, procedural sound effects, and real-time multiplayer collaboration. Players can create or join mission rooms, coordinate as a team, communicate through radio chat, vote on mission budgets, and work together to launch missions.

The project addresses the challenge of making complex space exploration concepts accessible through gamification and interactive learning. By combining simulation, artificial intelligence, and multiplayer technology, GTA NASA transforms traditional learning into an engaging experience that encourages creativity, teamwork, critical thinking, and interest in aerospace engineering and space science.
details:
1. What does the project do and how does it work?

GTA NASA: The Kepler Expedition is an interactive, multiplayer space exploration and mission simulation game designed to make space exploration engaging, accessible, and collaborative.

The platform allows players to experience different stages of a space expedition, from spacecraft preparation and mission planning to simulation and mission outcomes.

The project includes several key features:

  • Spacecraft Customization: Players can prepare and customize spacecraft before beginning an expedition.
  • AI Mission Architect: AI-assisted functionality helps players develop mission ideas and explore mission-planning possibilities.
  • Mission Simulation: Players can launch simulated missions, encounter events, make decisions, and experience mission outcomes.
  • Multiplayer Team Rooms: Players can create private mission rooms using four-character room codes and invite others to participate.
  • Mission Director System: A host can coordinate the expedition, manage team roles, and organize mission activities.
  • Real-Time Collaboration: Players can communicate through in-game radio chat and participate in shared mission decisions.
  • Budget Voting: Team members can discuss and vote on mission budget decisions.
  • Procedural Audio: Generated sound effects, including countdown beeps, engine ignition, rocket ascent, and stage separation, create a more immersive experience.

2. What are the benefits?

The project combines entertainment with educational possibilities. Instead of simply reading about space exploration, players can actively participate in a simulated mission environment.

Its main benefits include:

  • Makes space exploration concepts more engaging and approachable.
  • Encourages teamwork, communication, and collaborative decision-making.
  • Promotes creativity and critical thinking through mission planning.
  • Introduces players to spacecraft preparation and mission management concepts.
  • Creates an interactive environment that can encourage interest in aerospace engineering, astronomy, and space science.

3. What is the intended impact?

Our goal is to make space exploration more accessible to students, young learners, and anyone interested in discovering how space missions work.

We want to transform curiosity about space into an interactive experience where people can experiment, collaborate, make decisions, and learn through gameplay.

In the future, the platform could be expanded with more realistic orbital mechanics, planetary exploration, additional mission scenarios, scientific challenges, and educational modules inspired by real NASA discoveries and missions.

4. What tools and technologies were used?

The project was developed using modern web technologies:

  • React: Building the interactive user interface.
  • TypeScript: Application logic and type safety.
  • Three.js: 3D graphics and spacecraft visualization.
  • Vite: Development server and build tooling.
  • BroadcastChannel API: Multiplayer communication and synchronization across browser tabs.
  • AI Integration: Supporting AI-assisted mission architecture and planning.
  • Procedural Audio: Generating mission sound effects and immersive audio experiences.
  • HTML5 and CSS: Structuring and styling the application.

The project is designed as a browser-based experience, making it accessible without specialized hardware.

5. How is the project creative and innovative?

The creative aspect of GTA NASA is its combination of space exploration, gaming, artificial intelligence, procedural audio, and multiplayer collaboration into one interactive experience.

Rather than treating space exploration as a passive learning topic, we turn it into a collaborative mission where players can take different roles, coordinate decisions, manage resources, and experience mission sequences together.

The multiplayer mission room, AI-assisted mission architecture, and interactive mission workflow distinguish the project from a conventional space-themed game.

6. What factors did the team consider?

During development, we considered several important factors:

  • Accessibility: Making the experience available through a standard web browser.
  • Engagement: Creating interactive features that keep players involved.
  • Collaboration: Allowing multiple players to coordinate and make decisions.
  • Educational Value: Keeping the experience connected to real-world space exploration concepts.
  • Technical Feasibility: Using modern web technologies to build a functional browser-based experience.
  • Scalability: Designing the project so that additional missions, features, and learning experiences can be introduced later.

Ultimately, GTA NASA: The Kepler Expedition aims to bring the excitement of space exploration closer to people by combining technology, creativity, teamwork, and interactive learning.
